description: Resolve a chemical name (e.g. 'aspirin', 'caffeine') or a PubChem CID to its core identity and physical properties using the NIH/NLM PubChem public database (keyless, public-domain data). Returns the PubChem Compound ID (CID), IUPAC systematic name, molecular formula, molecular weight (g/mol), and the canonical SMILES structure string. Use it to disambiguate a substance and obtain a stable CID join key for further chemistry or safety lookups.

query.description: A chemical name (e.g. 'aspirin', 'sodium chloride') or a numeric PubChem CID (e.g. '2244').

name: chemical_lookup
